## 8127b8dce4c5

**Reproduced defect — advertised override controls are inert and unknown keys
are accepted.** The audited source SHA-256 is
`bde0b98d725733f0a4418065ca7da8505348043266d9b697a47c62c029b0f4cb`;
the expected canonical rule hash is `d90098ffa01c`.

With the same seed `0`, sample index `3`, and `difficulty="easy"`, requesting
`n_cells=1` and `n_cells=9` returns the identical 3×3 grid with one center cell
of color 5. The same call also accepts the unknown override key
`__override_contract_unknown_axis__=123`. Both returned grids pass the target's
current `self_check`, so the defect is not a rejected-domain edge case.

The official isolated override audit exited 1 with 2,010 findings and two
warnings across 55,710 draws. Its clustered root causes report all eight axes
(`grid_h`, `grid_w`, `palette_kind`, `n_cells`, `have_2x2`, `center_filled`,
`anchor_corner`, and `texture`) as inert. Exact calls, grids, hashes, and report
links are retained in `checks/audit/8127b8dce4c5/override_contract_repro.json`;
the full receipt is under `checks/audit/8127b8dce4c5-override/`.

This is an audit-only finding. I did not edit `generators/8127b8dce4c5/`.
